title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Chandayatha and Nila feel uneasy when they spot Karthika at the temple. Later, Chandayatha upsets Pallavan by giving him less money than he demands for his daily expenses.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Shruthi reaches out to Karthi with a sincere voice note, expressing regret for her actions. Meanwhile, Ragavan provokes Bagyaraj by drawing attention to Malar's changing attitude.

title: Bigg Boss
episodeTitle: BBTam Day 36: Masks Off in Open Nominations
description: A new leadership takes power as the first assembly boils over house rules. Chandini and Jason are punished for rule breaks, while open nominations spark face-to-face fury.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Tamizhselvi is shocked by Vellathai's blindness. Sethupathi and Dr. Nesan are arrested as Rajangam intervenes, leaving Mohana devastated and Abhinav celebrating the news.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Karikalan is grateful to Pooja for uncovering the truth and clearing him of the theft accusation. Madhu supports Arjun as Shyam speaks negatively about him.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: As Sivagami and Rajasekar begin their 60th marriage rituals, romantic moments unfold. Meanwhile, Rajeshwari fumes and Swetha gets angry over Vennila's sarcastic mocking.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Indhira resolves to continue her delivery job to support her family as her ill father struggles to work. Kumaran grows concerned when Sarasu laments work stress in her sleep.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Saravanan lovingly cares for Thangamayil and their newborn as Raji asks for a treat. Pandian scolds Senthil for slacking, leading him to secretly steal shop money.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Muthu asks Seetha to accompany him to reveal Meena's pregnancy to Chandra. Sinthamani plots with the watchman to thwart them, pretending that no one is home at Chandra's home.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Vetri surprises Abinaya by attending Sudar's school meeting. He urges the principal to address the bullying Sudar faces from classmates over her past.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Meenatchi rejects Poongodi's family gifts, sending them to a servant's home. Later, she prepares an herbal remedy to treat Poongodi, who suffers from severe stomach pain.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ganthimathi and Kumaresan advise Ilamathi to perform Navratri Golu Pooja to seek blessings for a child. Ilamathi then cleverly gets Kalamma to host the festivities at her home.
